description: This header defines classes and functions for handling civil time representations (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) in the Abseil C++ library, including construction, normalization, comparison, arithmetic, formatting, and parsing of civil time objects.

classes.name: CivilSecond
classes.description: Represents a civil time with second precision, aligned to seconds.

classes.name: CivilMinute
classes.description: Represents a civil time with minute precision, aligned to minutes.

classes.name: CivilHour
classes.description: Represents a civil time with hour precision, aligned to hours.

classes.name: CivilDay
classes.description: Represents a civil date with day precision, aligned to days.

classes.name: CivilMonth
classes.description: Represents a civil month, aligned to months.

classes.name: CivilYear
classes.description: Represents a civil year, aligned to years.

methods.name: FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats a civil time object into a string according to its type.

methods.name: ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses a string into a civil time object, exact format.

methods.name: ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Parses a string into a civil time object, more lenient format.

methods.name: AbslParseFlag
methods.description: Parses command-line flag string into civil time object.

methods.name: AbslUnparseFlag
methods.description: Converts a civil time object into a command-line flag string.
